title: Free Fire Max
rounds: Knockout Format – Depends on total number of registered teams. Each round eliminates the losing team until one champion remains.
rules:
1. Match Format

  • Mode: Squad (4v4) Battle Royale
  • Map: Bermuda only
  • Team Size: Exactly 4 players
  • Substitutions: No substitutes allowed during a match.

2. Weapons & Equipment

  • Allowed Weapon: M60 Machine Gun only
  • Banned Weapons: All other machine guns are prohibited.
  • Gun Attributes: OFF
  • Ammunition: Limited ammunition only.

3. Character Rules

  • Banned Characters: Sonia and Dimitri.

4. Gameplay Rules

  • Airdrops: Looting or using items from airdrops is strictly prohibited.
  • Panels: Use of any panel is strictly banned.

5. Fair Play & Conduct

  • No hacks, cheats, mods, scripts, or third-party applications are allowed.
  • Exploiting glitches or game bugs is strictly prohibited.
  • Abusive, offensive, or unsportsmanlike language in voice or text chat will not be tolerated.
  • Tournament officials' decisions are final and binding.
judging:
A team will be immediately disqualified for:

  • Using banned characters (Sonia or Dimitri).
  • Using any weapon other than the M60.
  • Looting or using airdrop items.
  • Using panels.
  • Using hacks, cheats, mods, or exploiting glitches.
  • Any form of unsportsmanlike conduct or abusive behavior.
  • Matches are knockout format
  • Performance judged purely on in-game victory
